verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's own docs describe an official TrueLayer MCP server that connects to Claude AI to perform banking and payment operations, and they name a concrete tool (create-truelayer-payment-link). A probe confirms the dedicated documentation page exists. missing for 10: the full tool catalog beyond a single named tool, setup/auth and hosting details, compatibility with MCP clients other than Claude, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: By integrating the TrueLayer MCP server with this AI assistant, you'd empower Claude AI to perform a range of banking and payment operations on your behalf.
create-truelayer-payment-link` - Generate a new payment link for initiating a payment from a bank account to the TrueLayer merchant account
